question: Can a Codex-area owner directly verify the pinned Codex app-server event contract and confirm that the top-level attempt `compactionCount` is the correct durable session-state boundary before merge?
rationale: OpenClaw policy makes direct inspection of sibling Codex source a hard prerequisite for a Codex verdict; this restricted review could not perform that inspection, while the PR carries a protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Verify contract, then land
options.body: Inspect the pinned Codex app-server source and retain the field relocation if its completed-compaction event semantics match the projector’s persisted attempt result.

options.title: Hold for boundary redesign
options.body: Pause the PR if Codex exposes a different authoritative compaction lifecycle boundary that should be normalized before persistence.

recommendation.title: Verify contract, then land
recommendation.body: Inspect the pinned Codex app-server source and retain the field relocation if its completed-compaction event semantics match the projector’s persisted attempt result.
